hook: YouTube ads, punished by the reload button.

beats.say: YouTube Ad Punisher is a browser extension that reloads the page the moment an ad appears, capturing your exact playback timestamp first.
After one or two reloads the ad slot is usually empty, so the video plays clean, with no waiting and no skip button hunting.
If three reloads fail, it switches to a helper tab for four seconds, then switches back, and the ad is gone.
